speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Intestinal Atresia. The combination of bilious vomiting, abdominal distension, failure to pass meconium, and the X-ray findings of dilated loops with no rectal gas confirms a distal obstruction, specifically intestinal atresia, which is a common cause of these symptoms in newborns.
